* Approximate annual rate is derived by multiplying the biweekly rate by 26.08 and rounding to the nearest dollar.
** Applies to all employees whose work week is 40 hours and who are eligible to be paid according to this schedule as outlined in the chapter "Attendance, Holidays, and

Leave," Title 4, Pennsylvania Code.
